title: Marked cone straightening: Quillen unit and counit
statement:
Use coherent realization $\mathfrak C$, simplicial categories and Dwyer--Kan equivalences from [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], marked simplicial sets and the absolute marked model category $\mathsf M$ of [lem-coef-marked-point-cartesian-model], and the relative Cartesian model $\mathsf M_S$ of [lem-coef-marked-relative-cartesian-model]. Use the enriched projective diagram model conventions of [lem-coef-simplicial-model-coherent-diagrams]. Let $S$ be a small simplicial set, $C$ a small locally Kan simplicial category and $\phi:\mathfrak C[S]\to C^{\mathrm{op}}$ a simplicial functor. For a marked $X\to S$ form the pushout of simplicial categories
$$D_X=C^{\mathrm{op}}\amalg_{\mathfrak C[X]}\mathfrak C[X\star\Delta^0],$$
whose new cone object is $*$. Define $\operatorname{St}^+_\phi(X)(c)=D_X(c,*)$. The triangle obtained by coning an edge $e:x\to y$ of $X$ induces an edge $\widetilde e:\widetilde x\to\phi(e)^*\widetilde y$ in $D_X(\phi(x),*)$. Mark the edges $g^*\widetilde e$ for marked $e$ and every $1$-simplex $g\in C^{\mathrm{op}}(c,\phi(x))_1$, including degenerate ones. Composition in $D_X$ defines the enriched $C$-diagram structure.

This construction has a right adjoint $\operatorname{Un}^+_\phi$ and is a left Quillen functor $\mathsf M_S\to\mathsf M^C$ for the projective structure. If $\phi$ is a Dwyer--Kan equivalence, then for every cofibrant $X$ the adjunction unit $X\to\operatorname{Un}^+_\phi R\operatorname{St}^+_\phi X$ is a weak equivalence, and for every projectively fibrant $F$ the counit $\operatorname{St}^+_\phi\operatorname{Un}^+_\phi F\to F$ is an objectwise weak equivalence. Here $R$ is a projectively fibrant replacement; all objects of $\mathsf M_S$ are cofibrant.

For $a:T\to S$, the cone-pushout construction gives natural isomorphisms
$$\operatorname{St}^+_\phi a_!\cong\operatorname{St}^+_{\phi\mathfrak C[a]},\qquad a^*\operatorname{Un}^+_\phi\cong\operatorname{Un}^+_{\phi\mathfrak C[a]}.$$
For a simplicial functor $\pi:C\to D$, the cone construction also gives $\operatorname{St}^+_{\pi^{\mathrm{op}}\phi}\cong\pi_!\operatorname{St}^+_\phi$ and $\operatorname{Un}^+_{\pi^{\mathrm{op}}\phi}\cong\operatorname{Un}^+_\phi\pi^*$, where $\pi_!$ is enriched left Kan extension, left adjoint to restriction. These isomorphisms agree with iterated substitution for composites and with the identity substitution. For $S=\Delta^0$, $C$ terminal, and $\phi=\mathrm{id}$, the functor $T=\operatorname{St}^+_\phi:\mathsf M\to\mathsf M$ has a natural weak equivalence $T\to\mathrm{id}$.
